summary.text: Megan Steele is a Republican state representative who has represented Kansas House District 51 since January 2025 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026. A registered nurse and online instructor, she serves on the House Education Committee.

paragraphs.text: Steele earned an associate degree from Central Community College, a bachelor's degree from Oklahoma Panhandle State University, and graduate degrees from Northeastern State University and the University of Texas Medical Branch.
Her career experience includes working as a registered nurse and online instructor.
Steele took office in the Kansas House on January 13, 2025, succeeding Representative Kenny Titus.
During the 2025-2026 session she served on the House Education, K-12 Education Budget, and Veterans and Military committees.
